ns0:g.ns0:text: Fugacity equality connects vapor and liquid nonideality corrections
Same fugacity units and compatible reference states must be used on both sides. The liquid reference includes pure-component saturated fugacity and a

ns0:text.ns0:tspan: pressure/Poynting correction when needed. Ideal low-pressure limit φ̂=γ=1 reduces to y
^sat; sparingly soluble gases may instead use a Henry
